chunks.text: Today we will talk about Kiribati.
Kiribati is a small island country in the Pacific Ocean.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Kiribati?
Kiribati is in the Central Pacific Ocean.
It is made of 33 small islands.
These islands are in three groups.
The Gilbert Islands, the Phoenix Islands, the Line Islands.
Some islands are far apart.
The country is very spread out.
What is the capital of Kiribati?
The capital city is South Tarawa.
It is in the Gilbert Islands group.
South Tarawa is a narrow island, but many people live there.
There are also villages and small towns on other islands.
How many people live in Kiribati?
About 120,000 people live in Kiribati.
Most people live on the main island, Tarawa.
The people are called iKiribati, say iKiribas.
They are known for being friendly, respectful, and close to nature.
What language do people speak in Kiribati?
The two official languages are Kiribati, also called Gilbertees, English.
People use Kiribati in daily life.
English is used in schools and for official things.
What is the weather like in Kiribati?
Kiribati has a hot and humid climate.
It is tropical and close to the equator.
There are two seasons, dry season from May to October, wet season from November to April.
It rains a lot during the wet season.
The temperature is warm all year.
What does Kiribati look like?
Kiribati has flat islands with white sand, coconut trees and blue lagoons, coral reefs and clear water.
There are no mountains or rivers.
The land is very low and climate change is a big problem for Kiribati.
What animals live in Kiribati?
Kiribati is home to seabirds, like frigate birds and terns, fish, crabs and sea turtles.
Coconut crabs, big and strong.
Reef animals like coral, starfish and eels.
There are no large land animals.
What do people eat in Kiribati?
Food in Kiribati is simple, local and fresh.
People eat fish, grilled, boiled or dried, rice and breadfruit, coconut in many forms, milk, oil or raw, pandanus fruit and taro.
Sometimes people also eat chicken or imported food.
What do people drink in Kiribati?
People drink coconut water, natural and refreshing.
Rainwater, collected in tanks.
Imported drinks like tea or juice.
Toddy, a sweet drink from coconut trees.
Clean drinking water is very important in island life.
What is life like in Kiribati?
Life in Kiribati is simple, quiet and community -based.
People enjoy fishing and swimming, talking with neighbors, dancing and singing, going to church, spending time with family.
Many people live in traditional houses made from palm leaves and wood.
What are some holidays and traditions in Kiribati?
Independence Day, July 12th.
Christmas and Easter with church and music.
National Culture Day with dancing and storytelling.
Family Day, time to be together.
People wear colorful clothes, dance tamwai, traditional dance and eat with family.
Some fun facts about Kiribati.
The name Kiribati is pronounced Kiribas.
Kiribati is the first country to see the sunrise every day.
The flag shows the ocean, a sun and a bird.
Most land is just one to three meters above sea level.
Kiribati may one day move because of rising seas.
Now you know many things about Kiribati.
You know where it is, what people speak and how they live.
You learned about the islands, food, culture and daily life.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
